findings.mechanism: The exception branch publishes an honest failed_partial receipt, closes handles/joins guard threads, optionally persists timing, closes the supervisor IPC endpoint and returns 1. The executor can terminate/probe a registered or recovered worker group, but is not that worker direct parent and cannot recreate its missing worker_wait report.
